units.source_text: 桃园式部卿亲王坐在看台上观赏。

en.t: Prince Momozono, the Minister of Ceremonial, sat in the viewing stand and watched.

units.source_text: 他看到源氏公子的容姿，想道：“这个人年龄越长，相貌越是光彩焕发，竟像有鬼神附在他身上似的。”

en.t: When he saw Lord Genji's appearance, he thought, "The older this man grows, the more radiant his looks become, as if some spirit or deity had possessed him."

units.source_text: 他反而觉得毛骨悚然了。

en.t: It made him feel strangely chilled instead.

units.source_text: 他的女儿槿姬回想：年来源氏公子向她求爱的诚恳，确非寻常可比。

en.t: His daughter, Princess Asagao, recalled that the sincerity with which Lord Genji had courted her over the years was truly beyond the ordinary.

units.source_text: 即使是个普通男子，女的也会感动，何况是他呢？

en.t: Even if he were an ordinary man, a woman would be moved; how much more so when it was he?

units.source_text: 这个人何以如此多情呢？

en.t: Why was this man so full of feeling?
She could not help being touched.
And yet she had no wish to become close to him.

units.source_text: 只听见她的青年侍女们交口赞誉源氏公子，使她听得厌烦。

en.t: All she heard was her young ladies-in-waiting praising Lord Genji in chorus, until she grew tired of listening.
